title: waxed lightly weathered cut copper stairs name fix
description: this texture pack changes the name of the waxed exposed cut copper stairs to waxed lightly weathered cut copper stairs
body:
this resource/texture pack changes the name of our beloved waxed lightly weathered cut copper stairs back to what it should be.
It also changes all the other exposed things to lightly weathered. (and yes, I will update it to include the new copper things when the drop comes out).
I left a little easter egg in, somewhere in the lang file. see if you can find it.

The pack will maybe say it's made for an earlier/later version but it's fine just click continue.                                                            
YOUR LANGUAGE **HAS** TO BE ON ENGLISH FOR IT TO CHANGE!

I've had projects rejected because of the description before but there really isn't much more to say.

edit: I forgot to do the copper age update but its out now! I forgot what the easter egg is and I don't have the project files anymore so I'm doing a different one

edit 2: I lied it's not out and I lost the project file and I'm lazy so it just fixes some of the names which kinda sucks but who cares.
